hierarchy-bundles.visual_critic_note: Intentional muted teal/salmon palette and clean card UI show design care, but the visualization is clipped at the bottom (layout bug) and the heavy dark edge bundle lines overwhelm the lighter circle fills, making the data encoding hard to read.
hierarchy-bundles.encoding_integrity_note: Encoding is structurally honest: scaleSqrt correctly used for force-layout node sizing, data-driven domains via d3.extent, key functions on node and link joins; minor gap is hierarchyLinkSelection lacks a key function, but full DOM teardown on regeneration prevents corruption in practice.
hierarchy-bundles.stress_test_note: Easing-param sliders fire `updateLayout()` on every `input` tick launching a new 1500ms transition each time; the tension-slider guard checks `.transitioning` class that is never set so `redrawLinks()` runs unthrottled; no explicit `.interrupt()` before new layout transitions; no touch/mouse event disambiguation on node handlers.
hierarchy-bundles.cognitive_load_note: Color-coded cluster structure is readable (4–5 Tableau10 hues, clear grouping), but 300 bundled edges on 200 nodes form a near-opaque black mass in the lower third of the Circle Pack view, burying node positions and overwhelming the hierarchy signal.
